title: Companion speaker-tags are inconsistent for the same character: dialogue is sometimes attributed to 'Osk' and sometimes to 'Brother Osk' within the same scene (e.g. in one Kingswood arrival banter block both forms appear for what is clearly the same person), which read for a moment like two different characters.
